narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 'Accure' laser treatment by having dermatologists share their personal trials and results. It addresses oily skin and sebaceous hyperplasia issues, showcasing real skin reactions and recovery expectations to build trust and encourage clinic visits.
